Seminars

Next seminar · November 28, 2026

Dissociação molecular ultrarrápida: influência da solvatação na dinâmica de fragmentação molecular

Debora Vasconcelos · Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Moderator: Isaias Gonzaga de Oliveira

Watch on YouTube ↗

The Saturday Online Seminars are the core activity of LAFMAT. Held weekly, they bring together Latin American researchers and invited international speakers to present recent advances and foster scientific discussion and collaboration.

Each seminar consists of a 50-minute talk followed by an open discussion with panelists and the audience. The seminars take place every Saturday.

Broadcast online and organized collaboratively by the affiliated institutions, the series provides an active platform to promote research in condensed matter physics and materials science across the region.

For previous seminars, please visit the Video Gallery. To watch the seminars live via broadcast, please access our YouTube channel: www.youtube.com/@Lafmatnetwork.
